verdict.rationale: Ledgy offers a companyCaptable API and 'custom views and exports' / report building features, implying data can be pulled out, but there is no explicit documentation of a native Excel/CSV export of the full cap table and complete transaction history, nor any statement guaranteeing unrestricted, anytime export without vendor lock-in. missing for 10: explicit CSV/Excel export documentation, confirmation of full transaction history export (not just paginated API deltas), and independent evidence that exports are unrestricted/always available.
